question: In the first volume, when the bandits enter the bar they destroy the door, so why is it that when they leave, it's repaired?!
answer: That was the work of the carpenter "Minatomo-san". He has a short temper, so he cannot pass by a broken door or what-have-you without repairing it. I assure you, this wasn't my mistake. (Text: "Don't joke around, punk!! Quit lookin' at me~").
